actions.cancel-payment.description: Cancel a payment. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
actions.cancel-payment.props.id.descript: The ID of the payment to cancel.
actions.confirm-mandate-funds.descriptio: Confirm that the PSU has the given funds. This API can be called using the mandate_token associated with the mandate or using a backend bearer token.
actions.confirm-mandate-funds.props.amou: A "cent" value representing the amount. For example, 100 == 1 GBP.
actions.confirm-mandate-funds.props.id.d: ID of the Mandate to be confirmed.
actions.create-mandate.description: Create a new mandate. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
actions.create-payment-link.description: Create a new payment link. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
actions.create-payment-refund.descriptio: Refund a merchant account payment, either fully or partially.
actions.create-payment-refund.props.amou: The amount to refund, expressed in minor units (e.g., 100 means 1 GBP).
actions.create-payment-refund.props.id.d: The payment ID for the payment to be fully or partially refunded.
actions.create-payment.description: Create a new payment. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
actions.create-payment.props.DeviceUserA: Used to improve the end-user's authentication experience based on the device type. If omitted, the `User-Agent` header will be used instead. Only considered if the authorization_flow object in the request body is specified.
actions.create-payment.props.Idempotency: A key that uniquely identifies the request. If the same key is sent in another request, the operation will have the same result as the first request.
actions.create-payment.props.PsuIpAddres: Used to collect and record the end-user's IP address. Only considered if the authorization_flow object in the request body is specified.
actions.create-payment.props.SignatureHe: Header containing the signature of the request payload for authentication purposes.
actions.create-payout.description: Pay out from one of your merchant accounts.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get-constraints.description: Retrieve the constraints defined on the mandate, as well as the current utilization of those constraints within the periods.
actions.get-constraints.props.id.descrip: The ID of the mandate to retrieve the constraints for.
actions.get-mandate.description: Returns a mandate with the stated ID. This endpoint can be called either by the regular `backend token` or the `mandate token` for that mandate.
actions.get-mandate.props.id.description: The ID of the mandate to retrieve.
actions.get-merchant-account-payment-sou: Get the payment sources from which the merchant account has received payments.
The ID of the merchant account into which payments were made.
The ID of the user whose payment sources are being retrieved.
actions.get-operating-account.descriptio: Get the details of a single merchant account.
actions.get-operating-account.props.id.d: The ID of the merchant account to be retrieved.
actions.get-payment-link-payments.descri: List all the payments associated with the payment link. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
Cursor used for pagination purposes, returned as `next_cursor` in the response payload of the initial request. Not required for the first page of items.
The ID of the payment link for which payments are being retrieved.
Optional limit on the number of payments to return.
actions.get-payment-link.description: Retrieves payment link details. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
actions.get-payment-link.props.id.descri: The ID of the payment link to retrieve.
actions.get-payment-provider.description: Returns payment provider details. This API can be called without the need for authentication.
actions.get-payment-provider.props.clien: Optional client ID to retrieve specific provider details.
actions.get-payment-provider.props.icon_:
Optional configuration for the type of icon:
      - `default`: Default icon with no background (SVG).
      - `extended`: Extended to a square with an appropriate background color (SVG).
      - `extended_small`: Extended icon with 192x192 px size (JPEG).
      - `extended_medium`: Extended icon with 432x432 px size (JPEG).
      - `extended_large`: Extended icon jpeg with 864x864 px size (JPEG).
actions.get-payment-provider.props.id.de: The ID of the payment provider to retrieve details for.
actions.get-payment-refund.description: Returns refund details for a specific payment.
actions.get-payment-refund.props.payment: The ID of the payment for which the refund was made.
actions.get-payment-refund.props.refund_: The ID of the refund to retrieve details for.
actions.get-payment-refunds.description: Returns all refunds of a payment.
actions.get-payment-refunds.props.id.des: The ID of the merchant account payment to retrieve all refunds for.
actions.get-payment.description: Returns payment details. This API can be called using either the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
actions.get-payment.props.id.description: The ID of the payment to retrieve.
actions.list-mandate.description: List all the mandates associated with the client. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
actions.list-mandate.props.limit.descrip: Optional limit on the number of mandates to return.
actions.list-mandate.props.user_id.descr: Optional ID of the user whose mandates you want to list.
actions.list-operating-accounts.descript: List all your TrueLayer merchant accounts. There might be more than one account per currency.
actions.merchant-account-disable-sweepin: Disable automatic sweeping for a merchant account.
The ID of the merchant account to disable sweeping for.
actions.merchant-account-get-sweeping.de: Get the automatic sweeping settings for a merchant account.
actions.merchant-account-get-sweeping.pr: The ID of the merchant account to fetch the sweeping settings for.
actions.merchant-account-get-transaction: Get the transactions of a single merchant account. If pagination is missing, add a header `tl-enable-pagination: true` to enable pagination.
Cursor used for pagination purposes, returned as `next_cursor` in the response payload of the initial request. Not required for the first page.
Timestamp for the start of the range to query (inclusive). Uses the ISO-8601 format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HHMM.
The ID of the merchant account to return the transactions for.
Timestamp for the end of the range to query (inclusive). Uses the ISO-8601 format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HHMM.
Filters transactions by payments or payouts. If omitted, both are returned.
Set the automatic sweeping settings for a merchant account. At regular intervals, any available balance in excess of the configured `max_amount_in_minor` is withdrawn to a pre-configured IBAN.
The frequency of the sweeping operation (e.g., daily, weekly).
The IBAN to which sweeping funds will be transferred.
The ID of the merchant account to set or update sweeping settings for.
The amount above which sweeping will occur, expressed in minor units (e.g., 100 means 1 GBP).
actions.revoke-mandate.description: Revoke a mandate. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.
actions.revoke-mandate.props.id.descript: The ID of the mandate to revoke.
actions.save-user-account-payment.descri: Save the account details associated with a payment for subsequent re-use. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
The ID of the payment to save the account details for.
actions.search-payment-providers.descrip: Returns a list of payment providers.
actions.start-mandate-authorization-flow: Start the authorization flow for a mandate. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.
The ID of the mandate to start the authorization flow for.
actions.start-payment-authorization-flow: Start the authorization flow for a payment. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
The ID of the payment for which to start the authorization flow.
Start the authorization flow for a payout. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payout you are trying to fetch.
actions.submit-consent-mandate.descripti: Submit the consent given by the user. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.
The ID of the mandate for which consent is being submitted.
actions.submit-consent.description: Submit the consent given by the user. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
actions.submit-consent.props.id.descript: The ID of the payment for which consent is being submitted.
actions.submit-form.description: Submit form details filled by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
actions.submit-form.props.id.description: The ID of the payment for which the form is being submitted.
actions.submit-mandate-provider-selectio: Submit the provider details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.
The ID of the mandate for which provider selection is being submitted.
actions.submit-payments-provider-return-: Submit direct return query and fragment parameters returned from the provider.
actions.submit-provider-selection.descri: Submit the provider details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
The ID of the payment for which provider selection is being submitted.
actions.submit-scheme-selection.descript: Submit the scheme details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
actions.submit-scheme-selection.props.id: The ID of the payment for which the scheme details are being submitted.
actions.submit-user-account-selection.de: Submit the user account selection option given by the user. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.
actions.submit-user-account-selection.pr: The ID of the payment for which the user account selection is being submitted.
